title: Publication is gated and collision-safe
summary: Publication is a separate accepted-main operation. Failed execution does not publish; successful source publication is either a new immutable tree, an identical no-op, or a hard collision when an existing target differs.
invariants: An existing identical target is a no-op, not a rewrite.
An existing different target is a hard publish collision; accepted version directories are never overwritten.
Publication occurs through AlchemyGitMainTransaction rather than direct mutation of the ordinary checkout.

provenance.claim: Publisher PASS gate, no-op/collision semantics and Git main transaction.
